description: G1 golden set — relationships. Golden causal and sequence relationships plus negative relationships that must never be recreated. Edges are evaluated two ways: (a) the pipeline three-way branch (explicit causal+shared entity => causal; temporal-only => sequence; citation-primary => causal, weak citation => sequence), and (b) the live r5 edges_causal_evidence_guard semantics. Includes hub-entity hard cases.

pipelineCases.name: explicit_causal_shared_entity
pipelineCases.text: The port closed as a result of the Houthis attack on shipping.

pipelineCases.name: hub_china_iran_temporal_only
pipelineCases.text: Amid the Iran tensions, China urged calm in talks.

pipelineCases.name: days_after_sequence
pipelineCases.text: Days after the ceasefire, talks resumed in Cairo.

pipelineCases.name: citing_is_not_causal
pipelineCases.text: Citing officials, the report said the base was hit.
pipelineCases.note: 'citing' is attribution — removed from causal triggers

pipelineCases.note: 'linked to' is associative — removed from causal triggers
